notes.spot-price: On owned hardware there is no spot-to-on-demand price differential, so any figure would be invented.

notes.image-scanning: Image scanning is an AWS-hosted vulnerability service with no equivalent here, so a finding set would always be empty.

iam.name: IAM
iam.title: IAM API Coverage
iam.seoTitle: AWS IAM API Operation Coverage on Spinifex — Spinifex Docs
iam.description: The AWS IAM API operations Spinifex implements, covering users, roles, policies, groups and instance profiles, with those the platform does not offer.

notes.codecommit: CodeCommit credentials and SSH keys; the service does not exist here.
notes.organizations: AWS Organizations is not offered, so there is no organization to report on.
notes.service-linked-roles: Service-linked roles exist for AWS service principals, which this platform has none of.
notes.signing-certificates: X.509 signing certificates are an EC2-Classic SOAP credential, retired by AWS.

rds.name: RDS
rds.title: RDS API Coverage
rds.seoTitle: Relational Database Service API Coverage — Spinifex Docs
rds.description: The Amazon RDS API operations Spinifex implements, for the managed PostgreSQL and MariaDB engines it offers, with those the platform does not offer and why.

notes.option-groups: Option groups configure engine add-ons for engines this platform does not offer, such as Oracle and SQL Server.

s3.name: S3
s3.title: S3 API Coverage
s3.seoTitle: Amazon S3 API Coverage on Spinifex — Spinifex Docs
s3.description: The Amazon S3 API operations Predastore serves on the platform's S3 endpoint, alongside the AWS-hosted features it does not offer and why each is absent.

notes.accelerate: Transfer acceleration routes uploads over AWS edge locations, which an on-premise deployment has none of.
notes.analytics: Storage class analytics and CloudWatch request metrics are AWS-hosted reporting services with no equivalent here.
notes.express-one-zone: Sessions authenticate S3 Express One Zone directory buckets, a storage class this platform does not offer.
notes.inventory: Inventory reports are an AWS-hosted scheduled export; a listing here is served live from the metadata store.
notes.object-lambda: S3 Object Lambda rewrites a response from a Lambda function, and Lambda is not offered.
notes.replication: Replication copies objects to a bucket in another region, and a deployment is a single region with no peer.
notes.request-payment: Requester Pays shifts transfer charges to the caller, which needs AWS billing behind it.
notes.tiering: Intelligent tiering, archive storage classes and the restores they need are AWS-hosted lifecycle services; objects here are held in one class on local media.
